name: Zoho
description: Zoho's MCP server gives you access across CRM, Mail, Books, Projects, Desk, and the rest of Zoho One. Each user gets a personal MCP endpoint from Zoho's dashboard.

setupSteps.title: Sign in to Zoho MCP
setupSteps.instructions: Open mcp.zoho.com and sign in with your Zoho account. You'll land in the MCP Client dashboard.

setupSteps.title: Pick which Zoho services to expose
setupSteps.instructions: In the dashboard, select the Zoho apps you want Vodou to access (CRM, Mail, Books, Projects, Desk, etc.). Save your selection.
setupSteps.gotcha: Only services you check are exposed — you can come back and add or remove them anytime.

setupSteps.title: Copy your personal MCP URL
setupSteps.instructions: Zoho generates a per-account MCP endpoint URL on its own subdomain. Copy it from the dashboard — it'll look like https://<your-account>.zohomcp.com/mcp/<token>/message.

setupSteps.title: Paste it below + Connect
setupSteps.instructions: Paste the URL into the field below and click Connect. Vodou will run OAuth against your Zoho account and register the server.
